name: 上贺茂神社本殿与权殿
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / scientific-educational. Create one Fanggu colored companion heritage plate. Image 1 is the EXACT existing line plate to color; lock its silhouette, framing, number of roofs, openings, steps and every major contour. Image 2 is documentary real-world photo of the same subject, for material color observations and identification only; do not replace Image 1's composition. Image 3 is a matte museum illustration STYLE sample ONLY: do not copy its Chinese building, warm palette or black background. Subject: jp_kamigamo_honden. Materials: Historic black-and-white source establishes geometry but not exact pigments. Render conservative natural brown timber, gray-brown cypress-bark roofing, pale gray stone base; avoid invented vermilion or gilding. Two shrines and paired steps stay distinct. Color only existing solid surfaces with restrained matte mineral pigment, thin charcoal outlines and very light texture inside solids. Exterior background and any true openings must be perfectly flat PURE WHITE #FFFFFF or preserved native transparency; absolutely no black ground, gray haze, gradient, paper texture, cast shadow, glow, checkerboard. No people, trees, labels, text, invented architecture or border. This is colorization, not redesign.
material_observations: 历史黑白照片无法确定原色；仅用克制的自然木材、檜皮和石材色，不称为考证复原。
